answer.book: A single Latin academic dissertation (Zurich, 1688), defended under Johann Heinrich Heidegger, on the dispute between Paul and Peter in Galatians 2:11–15, printed as one continuous text with a title page and closing words and no numbered or titled internal divisions on the sheet.

entries.title: Dissertatio textualis ad Gal. II. 11–15. De S. Apostolorum Pauli et Petri contentione.
